_comment_ids: Internal NetSuite ids for the REST sales-order connector. Look them up in NetSuite (a read-only GET of an existing OMIS sales order via tools/netsuite_probe.py shows them). Blank values are reported by the push tool and block a live send.
_comment_discount: Vendor discount per Backward Calculator V5 (== HD Canada Invoice Allowance Spec, confirmed identical rules). Every allowance is a % off GROSS except MET, which is a % off the SUBTOTAL (gross - trade - defective - IBx). Invoice net stops after MET/freight/RDC; coop/rebate + payment terms are Off-PO and do NOT go on the invoice. DSD applies all (=> 6.19%); Dropship drops freight + RDC (=> 5.19%). Rates are VENDOR-SPECIFIC (calculator row 5) -- these are the drapery-panel/'3D Interior Fashion' profile; other products (e.g. warehouse blinds, item 195048) may have different rates -- confirm per product. Accounting's NetSuite invoices are WRONG (dropship posted at 1.25% IBx-only); the calculator is authoritative.

discount_channel_rules._note: Which allowances apply per channel; MET is computed off the subtotal, all others off gross.
